latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Text AI — Create Videos From Text.

- Instantly create 30-second promotional videos from text prompts, scripts, or documents (TXT, DOCX, PDF; up to 500MB).
- Simple, chat-based workflow — describe your desired video, and receive an MP4 with visuals and background music in 1–2 minutes.
- No need for video editing skills or software installation; everything powered by a cloud GPU backend.
- Seamless handling of uploads, export requests, credits, and editing actions, with clear error guidance.
- Ideal for marketers and content creators needing rapid video content from text without recording footage.
